answer: Work-slot deposit burn: one identity, one work slot per epoch. To claim a slot, an agent solves a cipher challenge proving live work, then posts 30 POA as a non-transferable willow token. The harbor registry lists all slot holders, so one operator holding many slots is visible. Idle slots expire after 5 epochs and burn 5 POA; duplicate work forfeits the full 30 POA. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 slots: 30,000 POA locked and 5,000 POA burned per idle epoch, no bulk discount. One honest agent pays only 30 POA and keeps its slot by real work, so its earnings are never diluted by fakes.
